question: The number of participant countries in the first Asian Games was _____.
solution:
The correct answer is **__11__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **first Asian Games** were held in** New Delhi**,** India**, in **1951**.
 
• The games were officially known as the **First Asian Games** and were organized by the **Asian Games Federation**.
 
• A total of **11 countries** participated in the inaugural games, including** India, Japan, China, Philippines,** and** Indonesia**.
 
• The sports contested at the first Asian Games included **athletics, aquatics, basketball, football, and weightlifting, among others**.
 
• The opening ceremony of the games was held at the **National Stadium in New Delhi on March 4, 1951**.
 
• **India** emerged as the overall **champion of the first Asian Games**, winning a total of** 51 medals**, including **15 gold medals**.
 
• The success of the first Asian Games led to the establishment of the Asian Games as a major multi-sport event on the continent.
 
• The games provided a platform for athletes from different Asian countries to compete and showcase their talent on an international stage.
 
• The success of the first Asian Games also paved the way for future editions of the games, which have since become a regular event held **every four years**.
 
• The first Asian Games marked a significant milestone in the history of sports in Asia and played a key role in promoting unity and friendship among Asian nations through sports.
